[[File:CrystalControl.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The crystal control room.]]
The '''Crystal control room''' was a central structure under the [[Onrai square]] in the [[Seoul 5 city|main city]] on [[Seoul 5]]. It was the source of power for the entire city, due to its stock of [[Seoularian crystal]]s. However, a short time before the outbreak of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Unidentified Imperial scout|Imperial scout]] removed the main [[Key crystal]] from the room, which was used to control the powers of the other crystals.

A short time after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Imperials under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Drezzel]] discovered the city and the crystal control room. The [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]] [[Fem Nu-Ar]] and [[Ualp Xathan|Xathan]] who had accompanied the Imperials to investigate the ruins were eventually imprisoned in the control room for objecting to the Imperial plan to use the crystals for new Imperial weapons. They were rescued by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after he obtained the key crystal from the Imperial scout in a [[Gambling/Legends|card game]]. In an odd turn of events, Solo inadvertently used the key crystal to overload the other crystals, causing the control room to be destroyed
